editorial.blurb: Qiao Lin Hotpot is a beautifully decorated Chinatown gem where attentive servers guide you through interactive cooking with exceptional broths and generous portions of premium meats and vegetables.
editorial.insiderTip: Order during restaurant week lunch for great value ($30 prix fixe), arrive on a weekday when it's quieter for immediate seating, and ask your server to explain the spice levels before choosing — the level 1 spicy broth can still pack serious heat.
